data.name: Efficient Storage Mod - Configurable Storage Solutions
data.teaser: A comprehensive SPT mod that adds configurable storage containers and keychains with progressive sizes and trader levels.
data.description:
Features

- Progressive Container System: Multiple sizes for each container type (compact, standard, professional, elite)

- Map-Specific Keychains: Organized key storage for different maps (Customs, Factory, Interchange, Reserve)

- Barter System: Purchase containers with alternative currencies (Bitcoin, GPUs, medical items, etc.)

- Specialized Storage: Containers for weapons, armor, ammunition, medical supplies, electronics, and more

- Trader Integration: Items distributed across appropriate traders with loyalty level requirements

- Fully Configurable: Customize everything through configuration files

Configuration

The mod comes with a working default configuration in config/config.json that includes all containers and keychains. You can customize any aspect of the mod by editing this file, which is already filled with examples of various customizations.

Minor considerations

- if you have set a factor on price (like in SVM) then this mod has to be loaded first (so SVM caan apply the factor)

- The keychains will spawn, very very rarely by default. So, If you have a mod that changes the item spawns, it also has to be loaded after this
